info.title: YRUZ API
info.description: YRUZ social network APIs: REST (mobile/integrations), Legacy OAuth (third-party apps), Citations feed (AI crawlers), and internal AJAX (web UI).
info.x-guidance: YRUZ sells public social data, developer utilities and the YRUZ Toolkit per call over x402 v2 (scheme exact, USDC on Solana mainnet or on Base, eip155:8453; every 402 offers both; x402 v2 via the PAYMENT-REQUIRED header and PAYMENT-SIGNATURE, x402 v1 via the JSON body and X-PAYMENT). No account or API key is needed for any operation that has x-payment-info. Call the endpoint (GET with query parameters or POST with a JSON body), receive HTTP 402 with a PAYMENT-REQUIRED header, pay the quoted amount, then resend the identical request with PAYMENT-SIGNATURE to get JSON. The payment is bound to the exact input, so change nothing between the 402 and the paid request. Parameters are optional: without input a tool runs on its documented example and a list returns the newest items. Products: GET /api/audit?url= (website audit: TLS, security headers, HTTP/2-3, compression, SEO and AI-agent readiness, scored with fixes, 0.01 USDC) and GET /api/trending?period=24h|7d|30d&topic= (what is moving on YRUZ: top posts, hashtags, articles, threads, questions, 0.005 USDC). Crypto tools (fast, cached at most 60 s): GET /api/crypto/price?ids=btc,eth,sol or Solana mints (live prices, 24h change, market cap, volume; 0.002), /api/crypto/trending (trending coins, top gainers/losers, Solana trending; 0.003), /api/crypto/token?mint= (Solana token rug-pull check: authorities, holder concentration, liquidity, risk score; 0.005), /api/crypto/portfolio?address= (Solana wallet holdings in USD; 0.005), /api/crypto/tx?signature= (Solana transaction in plain words; 0.003), /api/crypto/fees (Solana priority fees and Base gas in USD; 0.002). Free catalogue GET /api/crypto. Agent tools: GET /api/extract?url= (any web page as clean Markdown with metadata, 0.005), /api/unfurl?url= (link preview: Open Graph, Twitter card, favicon, oEmbed, 0.003), /api/domain?domain= (DNS, SPF/DMARC/DKIM/MTA-STS, RDAP registration, TLS, scored, 0.01), /api/links?url= (broken-link check, up to 50 links, 0.01), /api/x402-check?url= (validate any x402 endpoint, v1 + v2, 0.005), /api/uptime?url=&keyword= (status, DNS/connect/TLS/TTFB timings, cert days left, 0.003), /api/wallet?address= (USDC + gas balance of a Solana or Base wallet, can it pay, 0.002). Social data: GET /api/search?q= (one-call search), /api/posts, /api/post?id=, /api/profile?username=, /api/profile/posts, /api/article?id=, /api, /api/forums, /api/thread?id=, /api/questions, /api/question?id=, /api/pages, /api/page?username=. Only public content is returned. Utilities: /api/util/<tool> (hash, hmac, uuid, time, base64, slug, json, jwt-decode, html2md, color, email, dns ...), free catalogue GET /api/util. Toolkit: /api/toolkit/<slug> with the slug of the page on https://yruz.one/toolkit (ssl-lookup, meta-tags-checker, url-redirect-checker, sha256-generator, markdown-to-html ...), every unit/data/time/color conversion at /api/toolkit/convert?from=&to=&value=, free catalogue GET /api/toolkit. Prices: 0.002 USDC per call; lists 0.002 + 0.0005 per item (max 0.02). Manifest: https://yruz.one/.well-known/x402.
